scope: 142 named targets and 75 provisional-designation entries from the discovery index checked against DAMIT, plus targeted mission/radar source checks. This is a dated archive survey, not proof that no other model exists or a claim to have qualified every non-asteroid entry.

additional.name: 1950 DA
additional.note: Published retrograde radar solution selected; 2014 Yarkovsky evidence rejects the prograde alternative.

additional.name: Apophis
additional.note: 2026 archive release of the 2018 preliminary Model B; original scale and published tumbling state.

additional.name: Donaldjohanson
additional.note: Original DLR/Lucy global DSK; observed and source-reconstructed regions disclosed; fixed display orientation.

additional.name: 1998 KY26
additional.status: deferred: newer model not openly downloadable in checked sources
additional.note: 2025 work revises size and period. Data availability offers generated datasets on request. Do not relabel or rescale the superseded public 30 m radar mesh.

additional.name: Torifune
additional.status: deferred: original calibrated mesh not located
additional.note: 2026 pre-flyby study says the CDS identifier will be supplied on acceptance. No post-flyby scientific mesh download located in the checked JAXA release.

additional.name: Dinkinesh
additional.status: deferred: original scientific mesh download not located
additional.note: Scientific papers describe reconstruction; checked mission data and both current/PDS Lucy DSK indexes did not expose it. Images and third-party simulator models are not substituted.

additional.name: Icarus
additional.status: deferred: original mesh download not located
additional.note: Radar study describes the shape; no author mesh located in the checked JPL index. Dimensions alone are not a replacement.

additional.name: Hermes
additional.status: deferred: original mesh download not located
additional.note: Published binary radar observations do not supply a qualified original mesh in the checked pages.

additional.name: Braille
additional.status: deferred: original global mesh not located
additional.note: Mission imagery and approximate shape studies were found; no pinned original closed scientific mesh was qualified.

additional.name: Annefrank
additional.status: deferred: original global mesh not located
additional.note: Flyby imaging alone is not a complete source mesh; no original closed reconstruction was qualified.

additional.name: 1998 QE2
additional.status: deferred: original scientific mesh download not located
additional.note: The 2026 LPSC abstract updates the primary and describes a bilobed secondary. The checked abstract and JPL downloadable-model index do not provide the original mesh. Figures are not substituted for data.

additional.name: 2004 BL86
additional.status: deferred: original scientific mesh download not located
additional.note: Radar imagery and published physical characterization are available. No original closed mesh download was qualified in the checked JPL index or source papers.
